paragraphs: Friend, here's what hits me about this one. Everybody at that cross keeps telling Jesus to save Himself. The people passing by say, "If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!" The chief priests, scribes and elders say, "He saved others, but He cannot save Himself." (Matthew 27:40, 42)

Now hear me, because this is the whole thing. They said it as an insult, but I think that line is true in a way they never meant. He saved others, and He stayed on that cross. I think that's what real love looks like, and it's why this day matters to you and me. Jesus said the Son of Man came "to give His life as a ransom for many." (Mark 10:45)

So what do you do with that, baker? You can walk away from a moment like this feeling small, or you can let it make you grateful. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and what pulled me out was being found by Someone who wasn't done with me. Hold onto that. The One on that cross stayed for you, and this story is NOT finished.
